goal: Decouple unexpected system failures like disk or memory errors from block validity checks
Stop forcing callers and storage functions to disentangle system runtime errors from invalid blocks
reviewability: Ready to review now despite conflicts with master because the rebase is mechanical
agreement: Broad interest in separating runtime errors, but disputed over error-handling style and safety risks
Objected that expected returns risk chain splits if callers conflate errors with invalid blocks (purpleKarrot)
Flattening results into booleans relies on reviewer checks rather than interface safety (alexanderwiederin)
Changing error paths alters miner error handling and validation notification behavior (optout21)
Support for explicit value-based error handling over exceptions (hodlinator, l0rinc, arejula27)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it cleans up error propagation across the kernel boundary for external consumers
Removes internal error enumerations from the C API to provide a cleaner reporting abstraction

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it prevents non-validating routines from needing validation state parameters for disk errors
Unblocks returning validation state directly from validation methods instead of boolean flags
